text: This report is about a matter that Toronto and East York Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided it is not amended, so it varies with City policy or by-laws. A significant increase in construction traffic is anticipated at the intersection of Leslie Street and Unwin Avenue due to scheduled City of Toronto and Toronto and Region Conservation Area (TRCA) infrastructure projects over the next five years. Transportation Services is requesting approval of temporary Traffic Control Signals at the intersection of Leslie Street and Unwin Avenue to facilitate the safe movement of construction traffic, bicycle and pedestrian users of the Martin Goodman Trail and Tommy Thompson Park, and users of the Leslie Street Allotment Gardens.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Approved the installation of temporary Traffic Control Signals on Leslie Street at Unwin Avenue to be in effect from September 1, 2018 until December 31, 2025.
